point.title: Generation Experiments and Evaluation
point.rationale: EvalRunService coordinates repeatable workflows over pinned canvas inputs, prompt versions, references, and AgentContexts. ExperimentService prepares and launches reviewed plans; comparison capture preserves selected checkpoints independently of later source changes. Materializers turn validated model output into canvases, while judgements and promotion connect evaluation results back to published work.

relationships.label: pins context hashes and resolves model-visible evidence
captures checkpoints and materializes generated canvases
publishes promoted outputs into the project catalog
reconciles chat-generated alternatives into evaluation runs
